newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian/U.S. yield spread sets new low.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian/U.S. yield spread sets new low.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread hit a new 2-1/2 year low on Wednesday of around 104 basis points, but profit-taking in the local market saw this edge back up slightly going into the close.
However, the spread remained under what had been resistance at 110 basis points.

Traders said the market had got a little ahead of itself after the long awaited U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting left policy unchanged and as thoughts immediately turned to a possible easing in Australia before the end of the year.

Local bonds also outperformed New Zealand debt, but lagged the Canadian market, which like Australia, was again contemplating an easing by its central bank after the Fed left U.S. rates policy on hold.
